test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Of the four words listed below, three are consistent in some manner and one is inconsistent. Select the inconsistent one.

Jio, Vodafone, Airtel, Amazon
solution:
Jio, Vodafone, and Airtel are telecommunication companies primarily providing mobile network and internet services.

Amazon, on the other hand, is primarily an e-commerce platform, not a telecom service provider.

Thus, out of all the options 'Amazon' is the inconsistent one.

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
